title: Polaris @ Woodlands — 4 Industrial Units (Side by Side)
subtitle: 4 Consecutive Corner Units
description:
4 consecutive corner industrial units available for sale side by side at Polaris @ Woodlands. Each unit is independently titled and can be sold individually or as a block.

Owner is open to a sale-and-rent-back arrangement at a higher sales price. Currently 3 units are owner-occupied and 1 unit is tenanted at S$7,150 + GST/month.
highlights: 4 consecutive corner units — rare en-bloc opportunity
Open to sale-and-rent-back at higher price
Individual unit sizes: approx. 3,347–3,510 sqft strata each
